senses.sense_definition: An alternative form of <w>arango</w>, referring to a type of bead formerly used as currency in trade with West Africa.

examples.text: The merchant displayed a rare <w>rango</w> that had been traded along the coast centuries ago.
Historical records indicate that the <w>rango</w> was highly valued as a medium of exchange in regional markets.

traits.comment: Refers to a historical trade item no longer in common use.
